Beyond the course list

  • Overall GPA At least 2.0 overall GPA.
  • Graduation application Submit the degree completion application within the last semester of the anticipated graduation date.
  • Major course grades At least C in upper-level courses in the major.

Liberty’s transfer rules

  • Up to 90 semester credits from other sources can count toward the 120-credit degree.
  • At least 30 semester credits must be completed at Liberty.
  • At least 30 semester credits must be upper-level.

Pace used in this example

  • 2–4 completed outside courses per month is a planning assumption, not a provider promise.
  • 12–18 credits per university semester is a planning assumption.
  • Outside providers are studied one after another in this scenario; overlapping study can change the elapsed time.
  • University loads use unit totals. Prerequisites, whole-course scheduling, start dates, breaks and registration availability can add time.
  • One-time university fees are included once; subtract charges you have already paid.

What this range leaves out

  • Applicable sales tax on course subscriptions.
  • Books, supplies, course-specific charges and transcript charges when applicable.
  • Housing, meals, travel, health insurance and other living costs.
  • Rates are before financial aid, military benefits, scholarships, discounts and future price changes.
  • Completed or reported courses are excluded from new course charges; school acceptance of reported credit remains separate.
  • This is a range of known tuition, required university fees and selected outside-course charges, not a complete cost of attendance or a graduation-date promise.
  • Study.com uses the full College Saver Pro library price; an eligible lower-priced membership may reduce your cost.
  • Sophia uses the lowest published mix of monthly, four-month and annual memberships for the assumed study time. Prepaid plans require the upfront payment; promotions and tax are excluded.

Questions

Does Sophia English Composition I transfer to Liberty University?

Yes, for this degree. Liberty’s published transfer guidance lists Sophia English Composition I for ENGL 101 Composition and Rhetoric (3 semester credits) in the Psychology (B.S.).

Does Sophia Public Speaking transfer to Liberty University?

Yes, for this degree. Liberty’s published transfer guidance lists Sophia Public Speaking for COMS 101 Speech Communication (3 semester credits) in the Psychology (B.S.).

Does Sophia English Composition II transfer to Liberty University?

Yes, for this degree. Liberty’s published transfer guidance lists Sophia English Composition II for ENGL 102 Composition and Literature (3 semester credits) in the Psychology (B.S.).

How many credits can I transfer into Liberty University’s Psychology (B.S.)?

Liberty’s published limit for this 120-credit degree is 90 semester credits from other sources. At least 30 semester credits must be completed at Liberty. This plan proposes 78 semester credits through outside courses.

Which courses must I take at Liberty University?

In this plan, 42 semester credits are taken at Liberty, including UNIV 104 Instructional Technology for Successful Online Learning. Liberty requires at least 30 semester credits at Liberty.

How much does this plan cost?

The planning estimate is $19,371 to $20,879 before aid. It covers tuition, listed fees and the outside courses in this plan. It is not a complete cost of attendance.

Has Liberty University confirmed this plan?

This plan uses Liberty’s published degree requirements and transfer guidance. Admission and your own transcript evaluation are still Liberty’s decisions.
